core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Cardiovascular Drugs; Oncology Drugs; Gastrointestinal Drugs; Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)
specialty_focus: Boryung is a South Korean pharmaceutical manufacturer specializing in chronic disease treatments, particularly cardiovascular drugs (Kanarb family) and oncology products. It also produces gastrointestinal antacids and supplies APIs. It does not appear to have a wearable medical device line.
key_brands: Kanarb, Kanarb Plus, Dukarb, Tuvero, V.C.S. Injection, Velkin, Gelfos M, Taxotere, Alimta, Gemzar, Zyprexa, Besto, Yongkaksan, others
